source.citation: David Ross (2021), Automated analysis of bacterial flow cytometry data with FlowGateNIST
source.identity_evidence: Paper Figure 2 caption identifies panel A as buffer blank and panels B-D as E. coli; SI ReadMe.txt maps raw FCS names to those figures.

processing: Native FlowKit preprocess=True: amplification, gain and Time metadata scaling; source='raw' means uncompensated, not byte-identical detector storage.

display.histogram: 72 edges shared by both acquisitions; per-bin percent, not density per linear a.u.

interpretation_limits: One cell acquisition and one blank, not biological replicates
No cell, singlet, positive or negative biological gate is inferred
Embedded spillover is recorded but not applied
No inference of affinity, viability, concentration or QC pass/fail
No FlowGateNIST algorithms were executed; this is not an author-analysis reproduction
